'''Three Scourge''' was one of three [[Scourge (unit)|companies]] of [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warriors]] that were carried by the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[Trickster|''Ksstarr'']] when [[Nom Anor]] attempted to stop a [[Myrkr strike team|Jedi team]] from slaying the [[voxyn queen]] on the ''[[Baanu Rass]]''. Anor attempted to pin the Jedi between the forces of [[Two Scourge]] and Three Scourge, but his plan failed.
